budget.starts_at: first real R11 physics integration; one elapsed deadline including pauses and all later development/build/training/evaluation
budget.reserve_rule: Reserve max(6h,1.2x measured scheduling cost) for protected P1/P2 nominal full remaining ladder dependency chains, including not-yet-unlocked downstream levels under conditional predecessor success, plus other intended eligible core work without double-counting reused qualification. Release downstream reservation after predecessor failure. If full84 or even nominal targets are infeasible, follow declared priority/fair common-sample rules, report missing stages and never skip gates, assume perfect speedup or prohibit all learning through an impossible blanket reservation.
budget.targets_and_extensions: 32768/flow remains target,65536 and1800/3600 conditional. All full targets require actual throughput and authorized time; no automatic extension or reset.
budget.interpretation: Conditional extrapolations from one short run, not measured long-task performance. Successful full horizons and complete0.5s training transitions assumed; early failures/cuts reduce actual simulated time. Material growth, observer and CPU contention may increase cost. Gates avoid spending on ineligible long cases but add independent stage costs; parallel environments cannot remove per-case30->60->300->600->optional dependencies.

development-trajectories-01.caption: Each trajectory is one declared development task, not a repeated-sample success estimate. Crosses mark true failures. Dotted lines show the3m endpoint and original physical/material limits; a contact failure can precede the height/tilt limits. Strain includes the evaluated, unapplied final boundary when a material-domain exit occurs.

reference-accumulation.caption: Actual state and the goal sent to MPC, on the same uninterrupted physical clock. The.215m/s line is the fixed reference cap, not a hard physical velocity limit. Versions are separate development interventions.

r10-dev11-last-RL-contact.caption: Exact saved C candidate FK and frozen causal force anchors, with2ms plan nodes and.2ms true material force boundaries. Predictions beyond the vertical termination marker are unobserved. The final boundary force is marked separately because the material-domain exit prevented its application. This is historical failure analysis, not R11 E30 qualification.

retained_kinematics_force_analysis.method: Recorded actual kinematics, current-force/position anchor; constant-average strain-rate local SLS approximation. Only observed forces/positions and original material constants; no true q/e. State-dependent rate uses observable excess over equilibrium force. This is conditional model-error analysis, not closed-loop validation.
